brief.subject: EUDR brief: Information System training set for November
brief.headline: Commission schedules November training on the EUDR Information System
brief.dek: Brussels publishes November training dates for the EUDR Information System, while new figures show EU forest cover holding at about 39%.
brief.lede: The European Commission has published November training dates for the EUDR Information System. Operators and traders filing due-diligence statements should check the schedule now.

sections.heading: November training for EUDR filings
bullets: The Commission released November training dates for the EUDR Information System on 2026-10-22.
The Information System is where due-diligence statements are filed, so compliance teams should plan attendance early.
The notice did not list specific session details, so check the official schedule directly.

sections.heading: Commissioner joins EUDR event
bullets: An EU Commissioner attended an EUDR event, the Commission's environment newsroom reported on 2026-10-27.
No policy changes or new guidance were announced in the item, so current obligations stand unchanged.

sections.heading: EU forest and habitat snapshot
bullets: EU forest cover has stabilised at approximately 39% of total land, according to Commission figures.
26.4% of EU land is protected, yet 81% of protected habitats show poor or bad conservation status.
These figures frame the EU's environmental case behind deforestation-linked trade rules.

items.title: New cocoa powder alternative targets GLP-1 trends and supply risks
